To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the oxygen enriching property of the cellulose derivative and liquid crystals blend membranes was improved by the addition of LCs.
the oxygen enriching property of liquid crystal blend membranes was improved significantly, and the membrane was stable for more than one month in a single step.

the oxygen enriching ability of the cellulose derivative/LC blend membranes is strongly affected by the LC phase transition temperature, and the membrane with a homogeneous structure exhibits high and stable oxygen enriching efficiency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the oxygen enrichment of air through the liquid crystal blend membranes.

a study on oxygen enriching property of the blend membrane, 10 30 mm thick, prepared from ethyl cellulode, cellulose nitroate, and cellullose triacetate with thermotropic cholesteryl oely carbonate (COC) or p heptyl, p' cyanobiphynyl (7CB) as a liquid crystal.
a new class of oxygen enrichment membranes, which is a blend of cellulose derivatives and thermotropic LCs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the blend membrane of ethyl cellulose with a small amount of LCs, especially cholesteric liquid crystal, can be used as a stable oxygen enriching membrane.
the blend membranes of cellulose derivatives and thermotropic liquid crystals have a high potential to enrich oxygen from air.
the blend membranes with thermotropic LCs are promising materials for oxygen enrichment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the blend membrane of ethyl cellulose with LCs is a promising material for oxygen enriching membrane.

the oxygen enriched air flux of the blend membrane is proportional to the LC concentration in the range of 0.5 3 wt% and is proportional to the square of the operating pressure, and is inversely proportional to the square root of the membrane thickness in the range of the membrane thickness of 10 30 mm.

oxygen enriching ability of the blend membranes can be improved by incorporating the LCs, and the LCs can be used as the plasticizer to increase the membrane thickness and to improve the mechanical properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the LCs can be used as a membrane material for the oxygen enrichment process.
the oxygen enriching ability of the LC blend membranes can be controlled by the type and concentration of LC and the thickness of the membranes.
the oxygen enriched gas fluxes and oxygen concentrations can be controlled by the operating temperature, operating pressure, and liquid crystal concentration in the membranes.
